QuestInfo.name: Arwen and the Glass Shoe
QuestInfo.0: Arwen the fairy from Ellinia has lost something...
QuestInfo.1: Arwen the fairy from Ellinia says she lost her #bglass shoe#k a couple of days ago, on her way to Perion. A monster covered in flame stole it! Fairies obsess over glimmering, shiny objects so she obviously wants it back... Time to hunt some monsters near Perion.
QuestInfo.2: You returned the glass shoe to Arwen in Ellinia. You got lucky, finding it off a nasty Fireboar As a sign of gratitude, she gave you a fairy item. It's gorgeous and glimmers like a star. Dang, maybe you can use this to make something special.

0.0: A few days ago, on my way to #m102000000#, I was attacked by a flaming monster and lost my #bGlass Shoe#k...
0.1: Fairies like shiny stuff. Even though you think it's just some trifle, I really need my shoe! I don't enjoy being helped by humans, but please. Help me!

1.0: Oh...! That sparkle. That shine. It's my glass shoe! Would you...please give it back to me? It's not like you need it...

yes.0: I will give you this special item, which only fairies can give. This item is very rare and precious... Please use it well... Farewell...

item.0: You haven't found my precious glass shoe! A flaming monster near #m102000000# took my shoe. Please get it back for me.
